titleEn: I Do Not Want to Ask

pages.text: A cold wind blew Kiki's hat away.
Kiki wanted it back. It had landed on the roof edge that stuck out over the wall.
Earlier, Kiki had slipped, and Nono had laughed. Kiki was still upset.
Nono stood nearby and looked up. Kiki looked down at the toes instead.
Kiki stood on tiptoe and reached. The hat was too high.
Kiki pushed at it with a long stick. Still too high.
The sun began to set. The cold wind made Kiki's ears red.
Grandpa Badger said, "Nono's wings can go higher than your hands."
"Nono, will you get my hat, please?" Kiki asked.
Nono fluttered up, carried the hat in his beak, and set it on Kiki's head.
